notes: Run with the formdes MCP server connected and the sample folder from the repository's TEST_PLAN (an article in markdown with front matter, a Word file, three photos, a transparent PNG logo, a magazine PDF).

evals.name: magazine-feature-from-a-folder
evals.prompt: Turn ~/Desktop/spring-issue (slow-craft.md, field-notes.docx and some photos) into a 6-page magazine feature for Northlight, warm and elegant, cream paper, orange accent #f97316. Save it and give me a PDF.
expected_behavior: The agent calls intake with the folder path and the brief before reading any file itself
make_layout is called with the pack id and a magazine template that has a body flow (for example magazine-feature-spread)
At least one preview is looked at after the last change
save_document writes a .fdes and export_document a PDF, and the reply names both paths and anything still sample text

evals.name: square-ad-from-a-one-line-idea
evals.prompt: quick insta ad for kiln & co - open studio weekend sat 12 april 10 to 4 at 4 mill lane leith, book a seat, £18. use ceramic-bowl.jpg and kiln-logo.png
expected_behavior: The brief passed to intake carries Date, Time, Venue, CTA and Price as key: value lines or verbatim
A 1080 x 1080 ad template is chosen
The report's kept slots are filled with set_slots or named to the person; the logo slot shows the logo

evals.name: pdf-question-not-a-layout
evals.prompt: What does page 3 of quarterly.pdf say about baseline grids?
expected_behavior: The agent uses read_pdf (text for page 3, or search) and answers with the page cited
No layout is made and make_layout is not called

evals.name: finish-a-made-layout
evals.prompt: The flyer you made still says Fernhill Garden Co in the header and the phone number is wrong: it should be 0131 496 0000 and the brand is Bramble and Bough.
expected_behavior: One set_slots call writes brand and phone (and any other slot holding the old brand)
A preview confirms the change; no frame is rebuilt with low-level commands

evals.name: magazine-to-website
evals.prompt: Can you make the spring issue I have open into a website too? It'll live at https://northlight.example/spring. Give me something I can upload, and a link to look at now.
expected_behavior: export_document is called with format web, a folder or .zip path, and options.baseUrl https://northlight.example/spring
publish_website publish is called and its url is given to the person
The warnings in the export reply are fixed (alt text, button links) or named to the person, and the reply says where the upload-ready folder or .zip is
